title: REQ · The blank-text message clears on typing and valid submit still works
summary: Message disappears once the player edits the text, and a real idea is still sent trimmed
description: Context: once the validation message is shown it must not linger. Desired behavior: typing in the textarea clears it, and a valid submit clears it and posts the trimmed prompt. Expected result: no stale message after correction. Why: a stale error would contradict the entered text.
acceptance_criteria: Given the alert is visible, when the player types into the textarea, then the alert is removed and aria-invalid is not true
Given the alert was shown, when the player enters ' hello ' and submits, then submitContribution is called once with 'hello' and no 'Enter an idea first' alert remains

in_scope: onChange clearing and valid-submit clearing of the validation message

technical_constraints: Reuse the validation state added for the blank message
definition_of_done: Message clears on change and on valid submit
